nom: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing UVLOCK Sun Cushion SPF 50

avis.titre: Cushion foundations? Yes! This cushion sunscreen? NO.
avis.texte: I'm a long-time user and lover of K-Beauty skincare. I've used and loved Iope, Missha, and Innisfree cushion foundations so I'm familiar with how they work. Typically they are quite wet to the touch when you first open them. Unfortunately, that was not the case with this Round Lab cushion sunscreen. I tried putting on enough sunscreen with the puff to cover my face, and I was having to stab at the cushion to get any visible product on it. I finally gave up after getting the thinnest layer on my face and returned it.

I love the Round Lab Birch Juice Sunscreen line. This one is SUPER convenient for reapplication and it does okay over a skin tint. There is a bit of a white cast when reapplying so it may not work as well over makeup.

avis.titre: Love the product, very little for the price
avis.texte: I generally love Birch Lab's sun protection products, so I was excited to try this formulation with the applicator and compact. The product itself is good, however there is very little lotion in the cushion compact. I've used this product 3 times and am struggling to get enough product out to apply evenly.

Applies on easily and doesn't smell or give me a noticable white cast. I'm a tan, SoCal Filipina so my skin color varies from tan to tanner but not like Michelle Tanner. Got this primarily because we got a Disneyland Magic Key so the Disney sun is strong. So after I've put our toddler in the stroller, I'm sweating bullets and all my morning SPF is out the door. So being able to quickly reapply is amazing! I wish the pact was a little smaller but it's not too bad, it still fits in my slingback.
Unfortunately this product is very splotchy even with intense blending. To get to the product under the pads also takes too much effort. I use another compact spf and do not face these issues.
This is a great sunscreen for a touch up outside and you don't want sunscreen on your fingers.

I ordered this product based on someone's instagram that I follow. That also enjoy round lab products. The only draw back for them was they stated it leaves their skin a little too white. I am pale. So I don't notice it. My skin tone is very pink but this product is great when I'm outside a tone and don't have the tube! I have used it on my face, neck and tops of hands. I'm outside a majority of the time and I'm still not burnt! I have not had any break outs and it's not harsh on my skin. Definitely a products I'm going to keep in stock in my house.

I picked this up because I was intrigued by the idea of a cushion sunscreen. I really like the formula of the sunscreen itself - it applies nicely, blends easily, and leaves my skin feeling moisturised. My only complaint is that it's hard to really tell how much product is in the cushion and how much will come out on the puff, so I worry that I'm not applying enough or applying it evenly. It would also be nice if we could buy refill cushions. I haven't had any irritation while using it, and a lot of sunscreens cause major breakouts for me.
This is by far one of the best sunscreens I've had. I've used their sunscreen stick but this one is much more convenient. I love how portable it is! Great for sensitive skin.
This is super nice and light while still providing the SPF I need, and I can still apply makeup over it
I have a very deep complexion & this does not leave a cast & definitely protects my incredibly sensitive skin!

avis.titre: Amount of product you get is insulting…
avis.texte: Concept and product in general is great. I like that its a mineral sunscreen but blends in seamlessly without leaving a white cast so its good for reapplication. Idk how its going to be on top of makeup but well see. I wouldve recommended it IF the quantity matched up to the price but how little product you get is actually insulting.

So ive been using round lab for a while, this SPF is great i give 3 stars cuz it lasted only like a week, i did love how easy is to apply it with cushion, but the actual cream in the tube lasts a month or more, this was not worth the price

avis.titre: I would not buy this product again!
avis.texte: I would not buy this product for the following reason: Not enough moisturizer in the container. Does noes not last 10 days when you use it every day. Too pricy for the amount of the product. But the moisturizer is excellent.
This is my second purchase of the sun cushion. It is convenient to carry It is not sticky and it gives full coverage with comfort. Its my go to everyday. Thank you

I absolutely love this product. It is so easy to reapply my sunscreen throughout the day. Its lightweight and has a cooling effect when applied. There is a minimal amount of white cast initially - but after a few extra pats its gone and just looks very dewey

avis.titre: Love this sunscreen cushion a lot
avis.texte: It's a beautiful mineral sunscreen with a glass skin like finish. Wears comfortably letting skin breath with perfect amount of hydration and doesn't irritate the eye area. All untinted mineral sunscreens have some white cast initially. Someone with a lot of melanin may want to avoid untinted mineral sunscreens. I prefer untinted sunscreens to avoid the feeling of wearing makeup (that's what foundations are for) or worries about shade matching. I also do not have a lot of melanin in my skin. On me, the slight white cast disappears after 15 minutes so my skin looks natural and beautiful with this cushion. The compact is smaller than expected and there's not a whole lot of product plus no refill cushions to buy. If there's a good sale, I would repurchase a few of these cushions.
So smartly designed amd easy to use and oack wothb me! Excellent protection and lind to my skin!

Works great as a sunblock, but it leaves a very obvious white cast that you can't get rid of without rubbing vigorously. I bought it to reapply over my makeup, but it just made me look ghostly. Well made packaging.

First time using a cushion product on my face - I love it! I am already a daily user of the Birch Moisturizing Sunscreen UVLock SPF 45+ Broad Spectrum. I would recommend this sun cushion for on-the-go reapplication, it makes for an excellent beauty compact since it comes with a mirror. Love this product and this brand!
This Birch Moisturizing Sun Cushion SPF 50+ is easy for reapply sunscreen over makeup and can carry it in my makeup bag.
Easy to use and reapply! The sunscreen itself is my favorite.
This is truly a gamechanger for not ruining my makeup. Obsessed.
Round Labs sunscreens have been working well for me. So I had to get this as soon as it was available. This is perfect and makes applying sunscreen on the go so easy.
This product is great! I think it's really good for touchups.

I don't use this often, I bought it just to reapply throughout the day when my skin is too dry for a stick and needs something more moisturizing. I've really enjoyed it, though it does leave a white cast.

I like this moisturizing sun cushion, it has a round packaging it is very practical for its application it is hypoallergenic, it contains birch sap and Vita hyaluronic acid to easily moisturize dry skin and soothe irritated skin.
I press on it and almost nothing comes out. I have to press a lot and the application takes FOREVER. I live in Texas and I still felt the tingle of the sun wearing this.
Hard to spread even, hardly to get some sunscreen on the cushion. I think it might be me not knowing how to do it.

There's not very much product in the sponge that holds the sunscreen. After about a week and a half of use, the top of the sponge dried out. I had to pull out the sponge and flip it over to get the rest of the product. I ended up throwing it out after 2 1/2 weeks as flipping it over was really messy and inconvenient. If Round Lab could remove the sponge and make the sunscreen into a more solid form (or just a form that won't spill out of the packaging) where I rub the application pad directly against the product and apply it to my face, I'd buy this product again.
Easy to reapply throughout the day but does leave a white caste.

I have been trying so hard to find sunscreen I don't mind applying and I finally found it! I don't like the scent of sunscreens, I don't like how it feels on my skin, and I hate having to rub it into my skin because it makes my skin get red. But this is my new holy grail! It's so cute to apply it's like putting on foundation! I have actually been applying it consistently for 2 weeks now and enjoy it as part of my skincare routine! It makes my skin look dewy!

I was gifted this product since I needed a sunscreen on the go. It's very convenient to have in your purse when you need a touch up. The only reason for the 4 star is the cushion since I don't like anything touching my face. I hope Round Lab can create spray version of the Birch sunscreen. But overall, it's a good pocket sunscreen. Feels nice on the skin and it has not broken me out.

avis.titre: Feels like velvet on the skin
avis.texte: I bought this to put on top of round lab's Mild-up sunscreen for touch-ups and I LOVE it! It has a very soft texture and feeling to it and reminds me of velvet on the skin. It has no smell and is not as matte as the mild-up sunscreen, but they work well together and blend seamlessly. This is perfect to brighten up the under-eyes when you're not wearing makeup on comfy days. The container itself is very well made as it has a button right in front of it to easily open the cushion and has nice mirror. I don't think I'll run out of it anytime soon as I just use this on top of my other sunscreen base, but when I do run out, I'll definitely have to buy more!
I can even describe who practice it is to carry a cushion. Any time any where a touch up of sunscreen. You don't have to carry a bottle of sunscreen with the cushion you get your SPF 50+.
Very good tool to use with gloomy and create a beautiful face during late summer

I like using this product for sunscreen reapplication throughout the day. The formula is good for when wearing makeup because the cushion application will not smudge it. It blends easily on to the skin. I am glad that I bought this product!

avis.titre: This cushion compact makes it so easy to reapply my sunblock
avis.texte: This cushion compact makes it so easy to reapply my sunblock. I just love it. I don't often wear makeup, but when I do I find this sunblock just taps right over the top without disturbing anything. If you like the Round Lab Birch Juice sunblock, you'll love this!

avis.titre: It appears tinted but really does not cover anything.
avis.texte: I love this sunscreen. It appears tinted but really does not cover anything. I bought it as a sunscreen/primer. It has a radiant glow, but not in a weird way, just a brightening effect. Wears well under makeup. Does not minimize pores as much as I thought it would. Does not leave the skin feeling greasy.I love having this as part of my morning routine. I apply it last before my makeup and I get a super smooth finish with my foundation. Best part is that I always look like I have that "dewy" glow. I was very pleasantly surprised how lightweight it was and how it didn't leave me greasy at all.
super nice, only with more product can come off the cushion when used but over all easy to apply under the foundation, no white cast if done that way, and also easy to reapply over makeup.
Nice sunscreen Cushion !! Easy to bring in your bag and Easy to apply on the skin! Very nice!

avis.titre: Love the texture and the after effect
avis.texte: Love the texture and the after effect. It is great for oily combi skin. Only downside is I feel that the cushion has quite little product. Will repurchase again!

A non-nano physical sun cushion that protects you from UV rays, and allows you to apply it faster and easier than manual application. Core Benefits: ✔️Protects the skin from UVA and UVB rays ✔️Intense hydration ✔️Instantly soothes and cools down the irritated skin ✔️Clinically tested and Reef-friendly It is a cream type that applies smoothly and feels moist. I love the cooling effect it gives upon application. As expected for a mineral sunscreen, it has a slight white cast, but this melts quickly and you hardly notice it. It's unscented, has a powdery-silky finish, and gives a natural tone up effect. And it doesn't cause me any irritation. Fuss-free application on tricky areas like the side of the nose due to its innovative puff design. It's best for quick on-the-go touchups. It's compact, portable, and convenient!

avis.titre: I prefer this method over sunsticks for reapplying over make
avis.texte: While there's a slight white cast to it, it's an overall pretty decent product for sunscreen reapplication, and doesn't make you look super greasy. I prefer this method over sunsticks for reapplying over makeup.

avis.titre: Feels very light weight and leaves little to no trace
avis.texte: Feels very light weight and leaves little to no trace, it starts white and needs to be blended out the compact sponge is the best I've ever used.
I like this sunscreen but this cushion has a bit of a tone up effect

avis.titre: Amazing sunscreen and great for reapplying
avis.texte: Amazing sunscreen and great for reapplying, however this formula has a slight tone up effect. luckily I am very pale but on darker or tanned skin it may not look good. Over all great on my skin and very lightweight, also travel friendly!

avis.titre: super convenient to apply, especially when you're busy and i
avis.texte: This sun cushion is the second sunscreen from Round Lab that I've tried and it's great as well! The packaging looks so cute! Just like the stick, this is also super convenient to apply, especially when you're busy and in a hurry. I reapply every 3-4 hours and the cushion design makes the reapplication easy as well. This is lightweight, non sticky, makes my skin feel moisturized, and has a little scent to it – only if you smell it too close – but nothing like the usual SPF scent. Its color also makes my skin a little brighter, kind of like a tone up sunscreen, but blends well as long as you blend or pat it properly. Overall a great product and would buy again!

avis.titre: the puff is nice and squishy and the sponge with the sun cre
avis.texte: Secure packaging, the puff is nice and squishy and the sponge with the sun cream in distributes the product evenly. In terms of application, there is a white cast, but the sun cream itself goes on matte. It's good for re-applications in the summer, but may emphasise dry skin. Overall, the product goes on smoothly and doesn't feel drying on the skin.

avis.titre: very nice sun cushion for before or after make up, i perfer
avis.texte: very nice sun cushion for before or after make up, i perfer to use it after make up , it is so good to re-apply sunscreen on make-up. my first sun-cushion and i love it.

avis.titre: Texture is amazing and incredibly lightweight
avis.texte: Texture is amazing and incredibly lightweight, just make sure you know that it will make your skin tone a bit lighter!

I like Round Lab products. Have tried their Birch juice sunscreen, sunscreen stick and now decided to try sunscreen cushion. The cushion is quite compact. This sunscreen had a bit white cast and leave skin moist. Overall, I prefer the sunscreen in tube in terms of value, skin feel.

avis.titre: nice cushion for reapplication or something to quickly put i
avis.texte: Just a nice cushion for reapplication or something to quickly put in my bag. It does have a slight whitecast/tone-up to it so keep that in mind.

This is not my first time purchasing thid product. I love this little sunscreen. It gives me an effective and compact way of keeping sunscreen in my bag to apply on the go. Because of the compact that the cushion is in, theres no risk of spills. Additionally, i can easily apply this without any mess on my hands using the puff. I love this for a mess free reapplication of SPF when i am out for extended periods.

avis.titre: I can tell now why is this brand so popular.
avis.texte: I can tell now why is this brand so popular. This is the first Cushion type Sunscreen that I try and it works great. It does its job and also leaves a nice skin.

avis.titre: Absolutely amazing and hydrating sunscreen cushion!
avis.texte: Absolutely amazing and hydrating sunscreen cushion! It has almost a non existent scent and works well with my sensitive skin. It has a very subtle whitecast but it goes away quickly.
